title: Med-Flamingo
paper_title: Med-Flamingo: a Multimodal Medical Few-shot Learner
core_mech: 区别于单一投影接 LLM，Med-Flamingo 用 Perceiver 固定视觉 latent，并在多层冻结 LLM 中反复注入门控跨注意力。
core_mech_en: Compresses variable-number medical images via a Perceiver Resampler and injects them into a frozen LLM through tanh-gated cross-attention layers for few-shot in-context learning.
input_desc: 交错的医学图像、文本及若干上下文示例
input_en: Interleaved sequence of exemplar medical images, clinical text, and a query medical image/question
output_desc: 条件于图像和 in-context 示例的自回归医学回答或解释
output_en: Autoregressive medical VQA answer or clinical rationale conditioned on in-context exemplars

source.title: Med-Flamingo
notes: GitHub supplied no detected license and no root LICENSE/COPYING notice was found at this commit. Per-file permissions were not exhaustively audited; no permission to copy is inferred.

gaps: Med-Flamingo requires its visual resampler, cross-attention language bridge and original adaptation protocol. A generic image–text contrastive network is not substituted.
